facts.business: United Leasing and Industries Limited is focused on strengthening its position in the specialty segment with particular emphasis on its embroidery business.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: The Company has adopted revaluation model for land parcel. It is difficult for the management to have the correct value of land as on March 31, 2026, owing to uncertainties with respect to value of land. The land parcel may come under green belt area and road widening area.

key_risks: Uncertainty in land valuation due to potential green belt and road widening area classification
